name: Guyot Environnement
verdict: Breton waste-services group (Groupe Guyot Environnement, Brest, about 300 employees, about 30 agencies in the West) chaired by the Guyot family holding Hiru Environnement; one of the club's Club des 29 partners and a 2026-27 home-shirt chest sponsor. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: new sponsor record created for the 2026-27 home shirt (chest placement per the official launch photos). Registry shows HIRU ENVIRONNEMENT (Erwan Guyot Président de SAS, Giulia Guyot Directrice Générale) as Président of GUYOT ENVIRONNEMENT. No state or fund stake found → none.
